tools.name: find_gifts
tools.description: Find relevant OhGiftPlease gift ideas for a recipient, interest, vibe, occasion, or budget.

recipient.description: Who the gift is for, such as friend, partner, coworker, parent, or self.

interests.description: Interests, hobbies, personality traits, or things they like.

vibe.description: Desired feel, such as thoughtful, funny, weird, practical, cozy, or self-care.

occasion.description: Occasion, such as birthday, date night, thank-you, or just because.

budgetMax.description: Maximum preferred budget in US dollars.

tools.name: find_gift_guides
tools.description: Find the most relevant OhGiftPlease editorial gift guide for a gifting problem or topic.

topic.description: Gift topic or problem, such as hard to shop for, cooking, games, self-care, weird gifts, or under $25.

tools.name: find_impact_brands
tools.description: Find OhGiftPlease content about purpose-driven, women-owned, Black-owned, LGBTQIA+-owned, small-business, or Impact Brand gift options.

preference.description: The values-based brand preference or impact category the user wants.

tools.name: search_ohgiftplease
tools.description: Search public OhGiftPlease pages for a specific product, brand, category, guide, or gifting question.

query.description: What to search for on OhGiftPlease.

tools.name: browse_gift_categories
tools.description: Return direct OhGiftPlease category and Gift Finder links for common gifting intents.

tools.name: get_gift_finder
tools.description: Return the OhGiftPlease person-first Gift Finder when the user has a broad or uncertain gift request.

context.description: Optional summary of who the gift is for or what the user is stuck on.

tools.name: get_mcp_documentation
tools.description: Return official OhGiftPlease MCP documentation, privacy, terms, disclosure, support, and Registry identity.
